```{r, Data Read In, include = FALSE}
invert <- read_csv("combinedLongInvert.csv")
invert$month <- as.numeric(invert$month)
invert$iucn_protection_status <- as.factor(invert$iucn_protection_status)
invert$iucn_protection_status <- factor(invert$iucn_protection_status, levels = c("unprotected", "IV", "III", "II"))
invert$protection <- as.factor(invert$protection)
invert$protection <- factor(invert$protection, levels = c("take", "no take"))
invert <- invert |>
  mutate(bioregion = relevel(factor(bioregion), ref = "Central Victoria"))
```

```{r Filtering, include = FALSE}
abaloneRubr <- invert |>
  filter(species == "Haliotis rubra")

abaloneRubr <- abaloneRubr |>
  rename(mean_abundance = abundance)
```

## Blacklip Abalone Pop Over Time

```{r Population Graph, echo = FALSE}
Babalone <- ggplot(abaloneRubr,
                 aes(x = bioregion,
                     y = mean_abundance)) +
  geom_point(position = "jitter") +
  labs(title = "Blacklip Abalone Population Trend", x = "Bioregion", y = "Monthly Abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) #have to put after theme_minimal() or it will get overridden

Babalone
```

```{r}
abalone <- abaloneRubr |>
  filter(bioregion == "Twofold Shelf")

abaloneFiltered <- ggplot(abalone,
                 aes(x = year,
                     y = mean_abundance,
                     color = location)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15) +
  scale_color_d3() +
  labs(title = "Blacklip Abalone Population Trend Twofold Shelf", x = "Year", y = "Monthly Abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + #have to put after theme_minimal() or it will get overridden
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2013:2023)

abaloneFiltered
```


## "Basic" Model

```{r GAM Model}
model1 <- gam(mean_abundance ~
               te(total_mhw_intensity, mhw_days, k = c(5, 5)) +
               s(chlor_a, k = 8) +
               s(current_intensity_score, k = 8) +
               s(apparent_fishing_hours, k = 8) +
               s(ship_count, k = 8) +
               s(log_population, k = 8) +
               protection +
               s(year) +
               #s(years_since_start, bs = "re") +
               s(depth, k = 8) +
               bioregion +
               s(month, bs = "cc", k = 8), data = abaloneRubr, family = nb(), method = 'REML'
)

summary(model1)

saveRDS(model1, "modelBA.rds")
```

```{r}
# extract model output as a clean dataframe
model_output <- tidy(model1, parametric = TRUE)

# write to excel
write_xlsx(model_output, "model_babalone.xlsx")
```

```{r Diagnostics, fig.show = "hold"}
gam.check(model1)
```

```{r Visualisation, echo = FALSE}

all_effects <- ggpredict(model1)

```

```{r}
# create prediction grid
mhw_intensity_seq <- seq(min(abaloneRubr$total_mhw_intensity), 
                          max(abaloneRubr$total_mhw_intensity), 
                          length.out = 50)
mhw_days_seq <- seq(min(abaloneRubr$mhw_days), 
                     max(abaloneRubr$mhw_days), 
                     length.out = 50)

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  total_mhw_intensity = mhw_intensity_seq,
  mhw_days = mhw_days_seq,
  # set other variables to their mean/reference
  chlor_a = mean(abaloneRubr$chlor_a, na.rm = TRUE),
  current_intensity_score = mean(abaloneRubr$current_intensity_score),
  apparent_fishing_hours = mean(abaloneRubr$apparent_fishing_hours),
  ship_count = mean(abaloneRubr$ship_count),
  log_population = mean(abaloneRubr$log_population),
  protection = factor(levels(abaloneRubr$protection)[1], 
                      levels = levels(abaloneRubr$protection)),
  year = mean(abaloneRubr$year),
  depth = mean(abaloneRubr$depth),
  bioregion = factor(levels(abaloneRubr$bioregion)[1], 
                     levels = levels(abaloneRubr$bioregion)),
  month = 6  # middle of year
)

pred_grid <- pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    protection = factor(protection, levels = levels(abaloneRubr$protection)),
    bioregion = factor(bioregion, levels = levels(abaloneRubr$bioregion))
  )

# get predictions
pred_grid$predicted <- predict(model1, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")

# use same pred_grid from above
mhwplot <- ggplot(pred_grid, aes(x = total_mhw_intensity, y = mhw_days, z = predicted)) +
  geom_contour_filled() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "magma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Total MHW Intensity",
       y = "MHW Days",
       fill = "Predicted\nAbundance")

mhwplot
```

```{r Concurvity Figure, echo = FALSE}
# get pairwise concurvity
conc <- concurvity(model1, full = FALSE)

# extract the worst case matrix and convert to long format
conc_df <- as.data.frame(conc$worst) |>
  rownames_to_column("smooth1") |>
  pivot_longer(-smooth1, 
               names_to = "smooth2", 
               values_to = "concurvity")

# plot heatmap
ggplot(conc_df, aes(x = smooth1, y = smooth2, fill = concurvity)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red",
                      limits = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(concurvity, 2)), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Pairwise concurvity (worst case)",
       x = "", y = "", fill = "Concurvity")
```

## Testing for autocorrelation

```{r Correlation Prep, include = FALSE}
# find which rows were actually used in the model
used_rows <- as.integer(rownames(model1$model))

# filter dataframe to only those rows
correlation <- abaloneRubr[used_rows, ] |>
  mutate(year_month_num = as.numeric(as.Date(paste0(year_month, "_01"),
                                             format = "%Y_%m_%d")))

# verify
nrow(correlation)  # should be 1004
```

```{r Spatial Autocorrelation, echo = FALSE}
# simulate residuals
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model1)

# aggregate residuals by location (for spatial autocorrelation test)
sim_res_agg <- recalculateResiduals(sim_res, 
                                     group = paste(correlation$longitude, 
                                                   correlation$latitude))

# get unique locations for the test
unique_locs <- correlation |>
  distinct(longitude, latitude)

testSpatialAutocorrelation(sim_res_agg,
                           x = unique_locs$longitude,
                           y = unique_locs$latitude)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# step 1: find valid time periods
valid_times <- correlation |>
  group_by(year_month_num) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  pull(year_month_num)

# step 2: create logical vector (must be same length as sim_res = 1004)
valid_logical <- correlation$year_month_num %in% valid_times

# check length before proceeding
cat("sim_res length:", length(sim_res$scaledResiduals), "\n")
cat("valid_logical length:", length(valid_logical), "\n")
cat("valid rows:", sum(valid_logical), "\n")

# step 3: recalculate residuals
sim_res_agg_time <- recalculateResiduals(sim_res, 
                                          group = correlation$year_month_num,
                                          sel = valid_logical)

# step 4: test
unique_time <- sort(unique(correlation$year_month_num[valid_logical]))
testTemporalAutocorrelation(sim_res_agg_time,
                            time = unique_time)
```

```{r}
currents |>
  add_confint() |>
  ggplot(aes(y = .estimate, x = current_intensity_score)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#000000") +
  geom_line(color = "#000000", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_rug(data = abaloneRubr,  # use your actual data
           aes(x = current_intensity_score),
           inherit.aes = FALSE, #don't inherit y value from earlier ggplot aes call
           alpha = 0.3, sides = "b") +
  labs(
    y = "Partial Effect",
    x = "Current Intensity Score",
    title = expression("Partial Effect of Current Intensity Score, Blacklip Abalone")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
